notes.title: Patch 1.04 & Better Physics!
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
● The game's physics have been reworked and now it's much more fun to play!
● Grabbing things became easier.
● Health indicator is improved.

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
● Fixed a bug where lasers won't disappear.
● Fixed a bug where players would occasionally experience lag in PvP gamemodes.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
● Reworked itemgeneration in Quick Game and in PvP gamemodes.

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
● Candy-axe's hitbox fixed.
● Ready-indicator in 1v1 menu fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
● Few sounds added.
● Countdown became more visible on all maps.
● Shotgun damage nerfed.

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
● "White Death" and "Hack&\" achievements now unlock properly.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.01A
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where too much blood on the screen could crash the game sometimes.
-Online Cooperative matches are much more stable now.
-Removed a developer tool which could have used to get an insane amount of money, if exposed.

notes.title: The Ragdoll is out with 25% off!
notes.content:
[h1]The Ragdoll is released now, so go grab your friends and buy within a week to save 25%![/h1]

If you are experiencing any type of bugs or would simply make a suggestion about any aspect of the game feel free to write on the forums, I'll try to give an answer for everyone as soon as possible!

notes.title: This game is alive and coming in November 18!
notes.content:
[h1]After a year of struggling The Ragdoll is finally coming out![/h1]

This game had a rough last year but after facing several serious problems, the 1.0 version is ready to launch with improved content. I apologize to everyone who were waiting for this game and thought it will never be completed but the developing process was a lot harder than I thought and for a long time it really seemed that it might be never done in a proper way. But here we are, The Ragdoll will release soon and will receive further content updates in the future too!

In the last fourteen months it got more items, skins and much more firearms (including laser guns!) along with other improvements. Now, if you are getting lonely in your solo plays you can snuggle up on your couch with a friend and fight against each other or a large group of ragdolls in the Quick Game. Or just obliterate other couch-snugglers. It's your choice! 

Unfortunately you can't play this kind of deathmatches with your online friends (yet. However, it might work with Steam's Remote Play!), but you can challenge them instead or just invite them for a co-operative campaign.

If you are happy to see The Ragdoll finally releasing, please leave a comment or like/share this post so your friends could see the news too!

Have fun playing, and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Update and Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hi people!

Sorry for the long silence, life's been busy around here. Unfortunately the problem what caused the delay is still existing. The thing is, we want to deliver this game to you as smooth and enjoyable as possible. Almost everything is completely done, but the 2vs2 mode is still in developement. We think this is one of the core-features of the game, because who wouldn't want to beat other teams with his/her buddies, right? I can't really say anything sure, because after the work is finished it will still need time to actually get on the store and I don't want to break any promises. Anyway, until then more skins and objects are coming to the game, and I'd like to give you some sneak peek of the latter. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33431894/b0da3c6383209829bb93ea318c37e8914f649968.png[/img]

A few of you already reached out for us, and we're encouraging anyone to do the same. We'd happily receive any questions or tips, or whatever comes into your mind in our official e-mail (which is theragdollofficial@gmail.com ) or at the game's forum.
